gaps.text: insufficient information: The enquiry gives only a liquid and an in-line wish, so the known facts cannot justify a method choice yet. It also asks for confirmation that the liquid is measurable, which the supplied material cannot give: an in-line precedent for other liquids is a reason to test, not proof for this one.
In-line measurement of Temperature at the measurement point with temperature sensor
In-line measurement of Optical regime of the liquid (clear, turbid or opaque; optical density) with turbidity / optical-density sensor

Combining several spectroscopy methods (data fusion) (Fusion level: one model per method first, then a joined or score-level model with block scaling, because variables from different methods are not equivalent. Both techniques must look at the same small area of the liquid and the two data streams must be aligned to a common time step. Each method keeps its own calibration and diagnostics, and the fused model must beat the best single method on held-out runs, otherwise the second instrument is dropped.)

items.finding: The source states that a continuous process at a fixed probe location is intended to operate in a steady-state window, which simplifies model design, narrows calibration, supports validation by independent steady-state runs, and focuses online monitoring on drift and out-of-specification detection.
items.how_it_applies: This could inform the assessment by prompting questions about whether the customer's process is steady-state and what operational envelope applies, because the source links those conditions to simpler calibration and validation.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The source concerns a continuous liquid-liquid extraction process in lithium recycling, so the steady-state assumption and model-design implications may not transfer to a different liquid, matrix, or process scale.
